verdict.rationale: Stripe's first-party tax docs claim to automate sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance on all transactions, and Stripe Billing issues invoices natively, so the core story is delivered through a first-class integration. The support rests on a single high-level line, with no detail on how tax lands on each invoice. Missing for 10: documentation of tax registration management, rate determination by jurisdiction, explicit per-invoice tax line application, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
